name: troubleshooting-fails-escalate
lines: No sound from my USB interface in Playback. I'm on an iPad, version 8.6.4, and I have time.
I checked the audio device setting, it's set to the interface. Still nothing.
Tried a different cable and a powered hub too. Still no sound.
Yeah, okay, let's set up a callback. Tomorrow morning, Central time, 555 010 0142, name is Elena Cruz.
